headline: Senior Data Scientist
summary: Senior data scientist with eight years of experience in retail, lending and research. I build and deploy machine learning models in Python, design the experiments that show whether they work, and explain the results to business owners without jargon. Recently I have led work on generative AI assistants for internal teams. I work remotely from Romblon.
highlights: Built a credit-scoring model for first-time borrowers that cut defaults by 18% at the same approval rate.
Designed a store-level demand model on three years of point-of-sale data (about 900 million rows) processed with Spark.
Led a retrieval-based generative AI assistant that answers policy questions for 300 branch staff.
skills: machine learning: classification, forecasting, uplift models
generative AI tools and LLM evaluation
